rules.development: 16 unused whole-seed blocks x3 frozen strong styles xboth sides xboth kickoffs =192 matched configurations; three separate sources =576 full native matches. No source/threshold tuning or cohort extension from these outcomes.
rules.statistics: Adaptive must beat BOTH v10 and original Architect on raw AND accepted points, with positive 97.5% whole-seed bootstrap lower bound (10000 resamples, RNG719331) and exact one-sided whole-seed sign-flip p<=0.025 for each comparator. This preserves the previous two-comparison conservative significance threshold.
rules.compact: No raw points regression against compact relative to either comparator; no extra compact goals conceded versus frozen v10.
rules.preservation: No raw points regression against any style relative to v10. Adaptive raw overall goals conceded and turnovers <=v10, pass completion rate >=v10, with >=5 actual adaptive-support episodes.
rules.safety: All original official-SDK, legal-action, zero-exception, no-reproducible-candidate-timeout gates. Extra raw deadline misses/1000 <=2; accepted mean <=v10*1.35+.04ms. Stock 20ms deadline,2400 ticks,one worker; preserve every original raw row and exact timeout repeat. No GC/affinity/physics/configuration controls.
rules.qualification: Only if every development gate passes. Freeze candidate and run reserved16 unused qualification blocks x12 frozen styles xboth sides xboth kickoffs=768 pairs against v10. Preserve every original qualification gate. Never change main or active champion or promote without explicit approval.
rules.telemetry: Accepted matching final movement commands identify executions. Pressure/rejection labels are diagnostics, not executions. Live native passes_completed counters identify actual completions; plan/recent-support links are associations, never causal goals/passes created. Telemetry does not affect policy decisions.
